request.description: Requires superadmin authentication and CSRF protection. Creates all parent features and sub-features from FEATURES.DETAILS in the host-creation transaction. TASK_MANAGEMENT is currently disabled by default.

item.name: Task Management
item.description: Admin management operations use /api/v1/admin/tasks and the existing admin role/CSRF middleware. Employee operations use /api/v1/app/task. Task responses use { success, message, data }, except dashboard-stats and kanban-board which return { status, timestamp, data }.

request.description: Returns { status: 'success', timestamp: 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm A', data: { columns } }. Same optional filters and sorting as getTasks: assignedToUserId (employee), search (task number OR title), status (database enum), priority, createdByUserId, customerId, visitId, dueDate, completedDate, dueFrom/dueTo and overdueOnly. Nested filters take precedence over top-level filters. Use { hostId: 7 } for all tasks in host 7. All matching tasks are returned without pagination, with four fixed columns TODO/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED/OVERDUE and taskCount equal to tasks.length. Deleted/CANCELLED tasks are excluded. Overdue pending/in-progress tasks (dueAt < current Unix second) appear only in OVERDUE, not TODO/IN_PROGRESS. Cards preserve database status and the full getTasks fields/user associations. Card dates use host formats; top-level timestamp uses the host timezone and fixed format above. Empty columns remain present with tasks: []. See Task_Management.postman_collection.json for detailed rules and response assertions. assignedToUserId accepts a single positive ID or an array of positive IDs (for example [47, 48]); array values match ANY selected employee, while all other filters combine with AND. An empty array [] means no employee filter. Duplicate IDs are deduplicated; invalid IDs or array entries return HTTP 400. Required top-level hostId must be a positive safe integer (or digit-only numeric string). Payload/authenticated host matching is temporarily disabled; a different valid payload hostId is accepted but does not change the query scope. Missing/invalid hostId returns HTTP 400 INVALID_HOST_ID. Queries always use the authenticated host, never an untrusted payload scope.

All-time statistics for the authenticated admin's host; a top-level hostId is required and no filters are supported. Returns { status: 'success', timestamp: 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm A', data: { summary, statusDistribution, priorityDistribution, userTasksMetrics } } with host-local timestamp. Excludes deleted/CANCELLED tasks. PENDING maps to TODO. Overdue pending/in-progress tasks (dueAt < current Unix second) count only in OVERDUE, never TODO/IN_PROGRESS. Summary percentages = distribution count / totalTasks * 100 (2 decimals); user efficiency = completedCount / assignedCount * 100 (1 decimal). The three summary percentages omit overdue, so need not sum to 100. Users with included assigned tasks only, ordered by assignedCount descending then userId ascending; inactive users remain included, deleted/missing profiles return null name/profileImageUrl without dropping their tasks. Empty hosts return zeros and an empty userTasksMetrics array. See Task_Management.postman_collection.json for response assertions. priorityDistribution always contains HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, URGENT in that order, each with { priority, label, count, color }. Colors: HIGH #f97316, MEDIUM #3b82f6, LOW #94a3b8, URGENT #ef4444. Counts cover the same tasks as totalTasks (including overdue and completed, excluding cancelled/deleted); they sum to totalTasks. Empty priorities return count 0. Required top-level hostId must be a positive safe integer (or digit-only numeric string). Payload/authenticated host matching is temporarily disabled; a different valid payload hostId is accepted but does not change the query scope. Missing/invalid hostId returns HTTP 400 INVALID_HOST_ID. Queries always use the authenticated host, never an untrusted payload scope.
Creates a PENDING task and CREATED activity record in one transaction. hostId and creator are derived from the token.

Use an admin JWT in TOKEN and the matching admin CSRF cookie/header (adjust the cookie name if configured). Send task fields directly as multipart text fields. title and assignedToUserId are required; description, customerId, visitId, priority, dueAt (Unix seconds), attachment remarks, and file are optional. Omit the file part to create a task without an attachment, or include one validated JPEG, PNG, WEBP, or PDF up to 10 MB under file. Let Postman set the multipart Content-Type boundary. Returns data.task and includes data.attachment only when a file is uploaded. Do not send taskId or taskCommentId. Task, activity, counter, and attachment metadata commit together; failures roll back and attempt uploaded-file cleanup. Notifications run only after commit. Existing standalone creation and upload APIs are unchanged.

Returns { success, message, data: { tasks, pagination } }. Non-admin users see only their assigned tasks. Optional filters.dueDate and filters.completedDate accept YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY strings, for example 2026-10-23 or 23/10/2026. Formats can be mixed in one request. The client's configured host timezone (HostSettings timezone, also used for response formatting) determines inclusive start/end-of-day Unix seconds for dueAt/completedAt comparisons, including DST. Both filters combine with AND; omit unused dates. Invalid dates, timestamps or null return HTTP 400. Legacy dueFrom/dueTo Unix bounds remain supported but cannot be combined with dueDate.

Admin-only tenant task list. Include the CSRF cookie and matching ADMIN_CSRF_TOKEN header. Optional filters.dueDate and filters.completedDate accept YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY strings interpreted in the client's configured host timezone (HostSettings timezone), matching response formatting. Formats can be mixed in one request. Each becomes inclusive local-day Unix-second bounds on dueAt/completedAt, including DST. Both filters combine with AND; omit unused dates. Invalid dates, timestamps and null return HTTP 400. Legacy dueFrom/dueTo Unix bounds remain supported but cannot be combined with dueDate. Success retains { success, message, data: { tasks, pagination } }. assignedToUserId accepts a single positive ID or an array of positive IDs (for example [47, 48]); array values match ANY selected employee, while all other filters combine with AND. An empty array [] means no employee filter. Duplicate IDs are deduplicated; invalid IDs or array entries return HTTP 400.
Returns task details and up to 10 recent comments, attachments, and activity records.

Admin-only tenant task details with up to 10 recent comments, attachments, and activity records. Each comment includes an attachments array containing attachments linked to that comment; task-level attachments remain in task.attachments. Include the CSRF cookie and matching ADMIN_CSRF_TOKEN header.
Updates editable metadata and writes an UPDATED activity record only when values change. Assignment is handled separately.
Validates an active field-app employee and records the old/new assignee in the activity log.
Admin-authorized start operation. Include the CSRF cookie and matching ADMIN_CSRF_TOKEN header.
Admin-authorized completion. Include the CSRF cookie and matching ADMIN_CSRF_TOKEN header.
Admin-authorized cancellation. Include the CSRF cookie and matching ADMIN_CSRF_TOKEN header.
Returns immutable chronological task activity with pagination.
Adds a task comment as the authenticated admin.

Creates a task comment and optionally its linked attachment atomically as the authenticated admin. Required: taskId and comment (1-5000 characters). Omit the file part to add a comment without an attachment, or include one JPEG, PNG, WEBP, or PDF file up to 10 MB. Optional remarks: up to 500 characters. Include the CSRF cookie and matching ADMIN_CSRF_TOKEN header. Postman sets the multipart boundary. Success always returns data.comment and includes data.attachment only when a file is uploaded; attachment.taskCommentId is set to the new comment ID. Uploaded media is deleted if persistence fails.
Returns chronological task comments with pagination.
Multipart upload as admin. Include the CSRF cookie and matching ADMIN_CSRF_TOKEN header.
Returns task attachment metadata with pagination.
Returns task attachment metadata after checking admin access to its parent task.
Assigned employee or admin starts a PENDING task. Repeated starts are idempotent.
Completes an IN_PROGRESS task, stores completedAt, and writes remarks to the activity log.
Cancels a PENDING or IN_PROGRESS task and stores cancellation remarks in the activity log.
Returns immutable task activity in chronological order with pagination.
Adds a non-empty comment (maximum 5000 characters); author and tenant come from authentication.
Returns chronological task comments with pagination.
Multipart upload field `file`; supports JPEG, PNG, WEBP, and PDF up to 10 MB. Optional taskCommentId and remarks fields.
Returns task attachment metadata with pagination.
Returns metadata only when the authenticated user can access the parent task.
